messages.2コイン目が表面的中するたびにコインを再使用し、表が続くほど火力が跳ね上がる暴食: A single-target Gluttony Slash E.G.O that reuses its second Coin each time it lands Heads, with damage soaring the longer the Heads streak lasts.
messages.コイン再使用: 2コイン目の表面的中で、そのコインを再使用する(最大5回、合計7: **Coin reuse**: On Heads Hit, the second Coin is reused (up to 5 times, 7 Coins total). Each reuse costs 1–2 SP. Base Power is a low 3, so whether it grows depends on luck.
messages.暴食脆弱と出血: 2コイン目の的中ごとに暴食脆弱1と出血を付与する。再使用で重な: **Gluttony Fragility and Bleed**: Each second-Coin hit inflicts 1 Gluttony Fragility and Bleed. The more it stacks through reuse, the harder later Coins hit.
messages.自己回復: 1コイン目の的中で体力最大値の15%(解析Ⅲは18、Ⅳは20)を回復: **Self-healing**: On first Coin hit, heals 15% of max HP (18 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 20 at Ⅳ). From Threadspin Ⅲ, healing beyond her max HP goes to the ally with the lowest HP ratio.
messages.食い意地: スキル使用時にメインターゲットがそのターンにダメージを受けていれば、: **Passive — Gluttony**: On skill use, if the main target has taken damage that turn, on hit it deals 5–10% more damage if her HP is full, or heals 2–5 HP if it is not (up to 7 times per turn).
messages.侵蝕スキル: 体力が最も低い対象を狙い、味方5名にも割合ダメージを与えて自分を回: **Corrosion skill**: Targets the lowest-HP target and also deals percentage damage to 5 allies to heal herself. Beware of catching allies.
messages.精神力が高い状態で撃つ。精神力が下がると裏面が増え、再使用が続かない。: Fire it with high SP. As SP drops, Tails increases and the reuse chain does not last.
messages.他の人格が先にダメージを入れてから撃つと、「食い意地」が発動する。: Firing it after other Identities have dealt damage activates Gluttony.
messages.暴食資源を出せる人格と組み、必要資源(色欲1・暴食3・傲慢2)を揃える。: Pair it with Identities who can supply Gluttony to gather the required resources (1 Lust, 3 Gluttony, 2 Pride).
messages.Ⅱ: 「食い意地」が解放される。火力の核は解析Ⅰから変わらない。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Gluttony. Its core damage is unchanged from Threadspin Ⅰ.
messages.Ⅲ: 回復量が増え、余剰回復を味方へ回せる。侵蝕スキルも強化される。: **Ⅲ**: Increases healing, letting surplus healing go to allies. The Corrosion skill is also strengthened.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復量がさらに増え、侵蝕スキルに敵討伐時の攻撃威力増加が付く。覚醒の火力の: **Ⅳ**: Further increases healing, and the Corrosion skill gains Attack Power Up on kills. Awakening's damage gains are limited to a higher Bleed cap and more healing, so it is likely a low priority.
messages.LCCB係長: S1(暴食)・S3(傲慢)で必要資源を出せる。: **[LCCB Assistant Manager](persona:0804)**: S1 (Gluttony) and S3 (Pride) supply the required affinities.
messages.エドガー家 バトラー: S2(暴食)で資源を出せ、パッシブが、速度が自分より低い: **[Edgar Family Butler](persona:0809)**: S2 (Gluttony) supplies resources, and her passive adds 1 Potency on Critical Hits against targets slower than her, likely making Gluttony Fragility easy to stack.
